scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,UI" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test:all: node scripts/verify-k8s-docker.mjs && npm run test -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.open: node -e "import('node:child_process').then(cp => cp.exec(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start http://localhost:4000' : process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'open http://localhost:4000' : 'xdg-open http://localhost:4000'))"
